name: hf-agent-benchmark
description: A benchmark for evaluating Hugging Face agent implementations and agentic language models on multi-step, tool-using tasks and scripted interactions to assess ability to plan, call tools, and complete goals. Emphasizes practical agent performance rather than single-turn generation quality.
reputation: A community-contributed benchmark used by practitioners experimenting with HF agents and agent evaluation, with modest adoption in the agent tooling community.
